rocket-launcher.name: Rocket Launcher
rocket-launcher.info: Rocket scatter is reduced by high base HP not aim. The displayed scatter value while aiming is the Maximum deviation in tiles from the target, covering ~95% of shots or two standard deviations. Rockets do full damage at the point of impact and decreased damage towards the periphery (down to 50%). Friendly units within the blast radius are affected. Corpses within the blast radius are destroyed. 2 turn cooldown. Equippable by Rocketeer only.

stun-rifle.name: Stun Rifle

Capacitor required to use occupies 1 equipment slot. Successful stun chance is higher if the target has low HP. Advanced versions have a better chance to stun targets. Does not work on mechanical units. Does not work with Run and Gun. Equippable by all Biosoldiers except Sniper, Gunner, and Rocketeer. Cannot be equipped by PFCs.
